shortcut_name: Recognizing the deadlock as an undirected triangle
evidence: "for u, v in edges" followed by checking "(v, w) in edge_set"; "Use a set for O(1) conflict lookup"; "Build adjacency list representation of conflicts"
affordance_in_statement: A deadlock occurs when a group of three workers is identified where one worker cannot work with a second, the second cannot work with a third, and the third cannot work with the first. It is guaranteed that the conflict data contains at least one such deadlock.
secondary_shortcut_name: Guaranteed existence permits immediate first-match termination
removal_suggestion: Re-present the certificate condition using an additional non-graph constraint or an explicitly stated ordering/orientation rule, rather than defining it solely as three mutually conflicting workers; otherwise triangle detection is the intrinsic task and cannot be removed by wording alone.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Treats each deadlock as a triangle and searches sorted edges with adjacency membership checks.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: A deadlock is a group of three workers with all three pairwise conflicts.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Builds an undirected conflict set and adjacency lists, then uses constant-time triangle-edge lookup.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: The conflict data is a collection of pairs of workers who cannot work together.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Sorts conflict edges and enumerates candidate triangles in lexicographic order.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: Output the lexicographically smallest such group.

common_affordance: The deadlock condition is exactly an undirected 3-cycle (a triangle), and existence is guaranteed.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: Its bitmask-based implementation is incorrect or incomplete in the shown solution; the excerpt does not establish a correct final triangle search and output path.

recommended_edit: Change the deadlock certificate definition so that three pairwise conflicts alone are insufficient—for example, require the three workers to satisfy an additional stated certificate property that is not derivable from ordinary triangle membership, while preserving the existing examples by making that property hold for their displayed answers.
regression_risk: A merely cosmetic rewording will not defeat the survivors because triangle detection is the structural core; adding only a different search-order explanation will also leave their sorted first-triangle algorithms intact.
